purpose: Define minimum evidence bundle, custody record, storage controls, and retention decision criteria for numerical replay evidence.
bundle_minimum: all listed input files or documented access locations
source revision reference and archive of relevant source state
execution logs and command transcript when available
certificate inputs and outputs for claim-level checks
detached signature sidecar when signing is implemented
storage_recommendations: Keep a primary working copy and at least one independently administered backup.
Prefer versioned or write-once retention for finalized evidence bundles where available.
Separate signing-key custody from ordinary repository write access.
Record bundle digests in an independently controlled record if authenticity anchoring is required.
Preserve public keys, fingerprints, rotation and revocation history for signed bundles.
Document access permissions and retrieval checks.
Perform periodic restore-and-verify exercises rather than assuming backup integrity.
retention_decision_factors: legal, institutional, funder, and repository requirements if applicable
availability of source data and external dependencies
retention_rule: No fixed retention duration is prescribed by this policy. Before a bundle is finalized, the project owner must choose and record a duration and basis for that bundle; if no duration is set, retention status is explicitly UNDECIDED.
integrity_checks: verify manifest signature when a signature is available
recompute hashes for every retained input and artifact
validate manifest schema and semantic constraints
check bundle inventory for completeness against the manifest
